wins.text: Q3 revenue of $13.3B came in above the midpoint of guidance and in the upper half of the guided range, up 4% sequentially
Intel Products operating profit of $3.3B, 27% of revenue, up $400M quarter-over-quarter on higher revenue and reduced OpEx
Altera revenue up 14% sequentially with operating profit turning positive; operating margins increased 900 bps sequentially
Secured multiyear, multibillion-dollar AWS commitment for a custom Xeon 6 chip on Intel 3 and a new AI fabric chip on Intel 18A; added 2 additional 18A external wafer design wins in the quarter
Awarded additional $3B in direct funding under the Secure Enclave program; advanced packaging business turned profitable as a standalone in Q3

risks.text: Non-GAAP gross margin collapsed to 18% in Q3 due to ~$3B in noncash impairment and accelerated depreciation charges for Intel 7 assets, reducing gross margin by ~2,300 bps and EPS by ~$0.61/share
Gaudi 3 AI accelerator revenue will fall well short of the $500M 2024 target due to slower-than-expected adoption, product transition friction from Gaudi 2 to Gaudi 3, and software ease-of-use issues

Lunar Lake's in-package memory architecture is having a 'significant' and 'meaningful' negative impact on gross margins and will weigh on 2025 gross margins as volume ramps; gross margin expansion expected to be 'muted' in 2025, particularly H2

$15.6B in GAAP charges including ~$10B deferred tax asset impairment, $2.6B Mobileye goodwill impairment, and $2.2B in severance costs; adjusted free cash flow expected to remain negative for full-year 2024
Altera inventory normalization expected to continue through H1 2025 as end customers work down inventory tied to prior supply constraints; billings remain below consumption

guidance_items.detail: Q4 revenue guided to $13.3B–$14.3B (midpoint $13.8B), described as modestly above current consensus
Q4 non-GAAP gross margin guided at ~39.5%; 2025 gross margin expansion described as 'muted,' particularly in H2 2025, with meaningful improvement deferred to 2026
Q4 non-GAAP EPS guided at $0.12; tax rate of 13%
2024 gross/net CapEx now ~$25B/$11B; 2025 gross/net CapEx targeted at $20B–$23B / $12B–$14B, down >20% vs. original plan
2025 OpEx target of $17.5B reaffirmed; positive adjusted free cash flow expected in 2025; workforce reduction of >15% on track before year-end

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: 18A defect density metrics and what yield thresholds external customers require before committing to high-volume production
Panther Lake and Nova Lake tile outsourcing mix — degree to which wafers are truly coming back in-house vs. remaining with TSMC
Strategic optionality beyond the foundry subsidiary model — whether Intel has evaluated more transformative structural alternatives
